_about.description: Generic ingredients the planner works with. Macros come from USDA FoodData Central and are filled in by scripts/fill_usda_macros.mjs from usda.fdc_id; do not edit per_100g by hand. eBag products link here via ingredient_id in ebag_products.json.
_about.macros_basis: per 100 g edible portion, raw/uncooked unless the USDA description says otherwise
_about.edible_fraction: share of the bought weight you actually eat (peel, core, shell, bone). edible_fraction_rules override it per product when the product name matches (e.g. fillet = 1.0).
_about.allergens: EU 14 allergen list: gluten, milk, eggs, fish, crustaceans, molluscs, peanuts, nuts, soy, sesame, celery, mustard, lupin, sulphites
_about.diets: diets this ingredient fits: vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, low_carb
_about.tags: for user exclusions: poultry, red_meat, pork, fish, seafood, dairy, eggs, gluten, nuts
_about.match: How scripts/sync.ts links eBag products automatically. include/exclude are case-insensitive regexes on the product name (\b = word boundary, Cyrillic-aware). categories = category groups defined in lib/ebag/config.ts. A product links to the ingredient whose include matches the longest text; ties are flagged for review.
